title: Peek: enter expands to the full entry in place — never navigates
description: Enter in the peek currently promotes to a real follow, replacing the entry pane and switching the index dimension — invalidating the two preceding panes. Instead, enter expands the peek overlay into the full entry (all sections, as the entry route renders) in a centered scrollable card; URL, index, and entry pane stay put. Space/esc close; references inside the expanded card remain real links. ui-map-1.json encodes it.
close_reason: Implemented and screenshot-verified; map updated in the same commit.

title: Viewer: rail navigates corpora, chapters primary; sections condensed to refs (flashcard peek)

Entry sections (defines, mentions, phrasings, relations, neighborhood) carry refs only, no run-in definitions/intents/glosses; the peek shows the reading text unclamped so content is always fully viewable there — seeing a concept is an intentional act, like flashcards. ui-map-1.json updated in lockstep.

The web viewer now literalizes unknown tags (web/components/MarkdownArticle.tsx rehypeLiteralUnknowns), but the generator should still markdown-escape '<' in definition/intent prose it writes into Terms/Phrasings sections and pages/lexicon.md so other consumers render it correctly too.
